verdict.rationale: The docs show users can create API tokens from their profile page ('Create New Token' under 'API Tokens'), and the client authenticates with an API key, so a separate credential can be issued for an agent. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be scoped, permission-limited, or restricted to least privilege. missing for 10: token scopes/permission restrictions, per-agent least-privilege controls, expiry/revocation documentation, independent corroboration.
